definitions.gloss: note; annotation; explanatory remark; added comment
definitions.explanation: A brief written explanation or comment added to a text, document, or map to clarify or supplement the main content.

examples.japanese: {地図|ちず}に{注記|ちゅうき}を{加|くわ}えた。
examples.english: I added annotations to the map.

examples.japanese: {注記|ちゅうき}を{参照|さんしょう}してください。
{報告書|ほうこくしょ}の{末尾|まつび}に{重要|じゅうよう}な{注記|ちゅうき}が{記載|きさい}されている。
examples.english: Important notes are included at the end of the report.

notes:
Composed of {注|ちゅう} (note, attention) + {記|き} (write, record). Used for supplementary information added to documents, maps, charts, and other written materials.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注記|ちゅうき}を{加|くわ}える — to add notes/annotations
- {注記|ちゅうき}を{付|つ}ける — to attach annotations
- {注記|ちゅうき}を{参照|さんしょう}する — to refer to the notes
- {注記|ちゅうき}{事項|じこう} — annotated items; noted matters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {注釈|ちゅうしゃく} — commentary, footnote (more detailed explanation, often scholarly)
- {備考|びこう} — remarks, notes (used in tables and forms)
- メモ — memo, note (informal; personal notes)
- {脚注|きゃくちゅう} — footnote (specifically at the bottom of a page)
- {補足|ほそく} — supplement, additional information
